_note: M35 — the onboarding contextual first-time hints. Each is surfaced by HintDirector EXACTLY ONCE EVER (a persisted flag), on the FIRST time its real trigger fires: first move (Player.gd), first primary fire / first dash / first enemy telegraph (the ability_cast_started cast/telegraph seam). Copy is DATA here (engine holds no literal), diegetic + instructive in Klein's own voice; the parenthetical names the control. HintDirector routes the counter-rite discoverability hint (data/rituals.json counter_rite.hint) through the SAME system — one framework, not two.

first_move.text: The fog parts as I walk. (WASD to move — double-tap forward to break into a run when the street turns against me.)

first_fire.text: The power answers my hand. (Left click to loose it — every strike spends something; watch the meter it draws down.)

first_dash.text: A half-step and the world lurches past me. (Dash — Shift — slips me clear of a blow, but it costs wind.)

first_telegraph.text: There — the air draws taut, a red tell before the strike. (That warning is my chance: dash clear, or break the cast before it lands.)
